_readme: Har customer ka apna block. Page ?e=<slug> se chunta hai; kuch na ho to
Google account badalna ho to bas `endpoint` (aur `secret`) badlo — naye
account me wahi Code.gs deploy karo, naya /exec URL yahan daal do. Kuch
transfer nahi karna, koi folder share nahi karna, aur guest ka link wahi
PASSCODE yahan NAHI hai — wo Apps Script ki Script Properties me rehta hai
aur server pe check hota hai. Yahan rakhte to page ka source kholte hi
dikh jaata, aur wo koi darwaza na hota.
